jobs_results.description:
Condiciones del trabajo ✅

Beneficios:

Oportunidades de crecimiento y formación, incluyendo acceso a más de 20.000 cursos gratuitos en Linkedin Learning.

⏳ Flexibilidad horaria y teletrabajo, con los viernes por la tarde libres y un 30% de jornada en teletrabajo.

Instalaciones únicas que promueven la colaboración y el networking.

⏰ Descuento del 30% en todos los productos y ventas especiales durante todo el año.

Menú diario desde 3€ en el boutique restaurant y coffee bar en los breaks.

Buen ambiente laboral con compañerismo y calidad humana.

☕ Coffee Chats con directores para intercambiar ideas y experiencias.

Acceso a TOUS Connect, la intranet corporativa para mantenerte informado.

Candidata/o ideal ⭐️

Analizar la experiencia del usuario en web y app móvil para aplicar mejoras de diseño y usabilidad.

Contribuir a la creación de una experiencia de compra única para nuestros clientes.

Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales y diseñadores seniors para... comprender los requisitos del producto y del usuario.

Participar en la investigación de usuarios y en la creación de perfiles para informar el diseño.

Grado en Diseño Gráfico, Diseño de Interacción o Experiencia de Usuario con Máster de especialización.

Al menos 2 años de experiencia en posición similar.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD u otras similares.

Valoración positiva de conocimientos en diseño centrado en el usuario y metodologías ágiles

jobs_results.title: UX/UI and Web Designer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola!

Mi nombre es Julio y soy un diseñador web y UX/UI de 30 años con experiencia en programación en HTML, CSS, Javascript y Wordpress. He podido especializarme también en UX/UI para profundizar en las metodologías de diseño y análisis más rigurosas, además de adquirir una amplia destreza con la herramienta Figma.

Junto con ello, he trabajado durante más de 4 años en el mundo audiovisual para los medios de comunicación más importantes de España como editor de vídeo, lo que me ha ayudado a desarrollar una gran habilidad en la construcción de narrativas eficaces que ahora estoy pudiendo aplicar en mis diseños para web y apps.

Soy una persona aplicada, acostumbrada a trabajar en equipo y en un entorno donde cada día es una nueva aventura. Si buscas a un diseñador resolutivo, apasionado y de gran calidad humana, estaría encantado de incorporarme a tu equipo. ¡Quedo a la espera!

jobs_results.title: User Experience Designer
jobs_results.description:
We're looking for a temporary Senior UX/ UI Designer to join our united, dedicated, and enthusiastic team at LINK Mobility, Europe’s leading provider of mobile messaging.

At LINK Mobility, we connect businesses to customers through our communications products and services that drive engagement and satisfaction during each stage of the customer journey.

You're probably already familiar with us: we're behind the messages you receive via SMS, WhatsApp, email, or even to check-in for your upcoming flight, receive delivery notifications, cash in a mobile coupon to your favorite store, and so much more.

It’s an exciting time to join LINK Mobility as we develop our award-winning communications platform as a service (CPaaS) offerings in this rapidly advancing tech industry.

We are looking for a versatile UX/UI Designer who possesses a strong foundation in user experience design with additional skills and experience in user interface design. The ideal candidate will be responsible for... conceptualizing and designing user-centric interfaces for our Enterprise Portal, ensuring consistency, usability, and aesthetic appeal.

The contract duration is throughout 2024-2025 and may be prolonged.

YOUR RESPONSABILITIES
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and customer support, to understand project requirements and user needs.
• Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to gather insights and inform design decisions.
• Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to effectively communicate design concepts and interactions.
• Develop user personas, user journeys, and information architecture to guide the design process.
• Apply principles of user-centered design to create intuitive and accessible interfaces that enhance the overall user experience.
• Utilize industry-standard tools and software to design and prototype user interfaces, such as Figma, or similar.
• Stay updated on emerging trends, best practices, and technologies in UX/UI design to continually improve design processes and solutions.
• Collaborate with developers to ensure the successful implementation of design specifications and maintain design consistency throughout the development lifecycle.

WE HOPE YOU HAVE
• Solid experience as a UX/UI designer in a similar role, preferably within the B2B market.
• +5 years of experience in UX design, with a strong portfolio showcasing successful projects and a deep understanding of UX principles and methodologies.
• Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field.
• Experience of working on large-scale and complex IT projects.
• Fluency in English is a must.

OUR IDEAL MATCH IS
• Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a team-oriented environment and are eager to contribute your unique perspective while respecting and valuing the contributions of others.
• Adaptability: You approach challenges with a growth mindset and embrace opportunities for learning and development.
• Empathy: You possess a deep empathy for users and a commitment to designing experiences that meet their needs and exceed their expectations.
• Problem-Solving Skills: You are a strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills, able to analyze complex problems and develop creative solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
• Attention to Detail: You have a keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• Positive Attitude: You bring a positive attitude and enthusiasm to your work, inspiring those around you with your passion for design and dedication to excellence.

WE CAN OFFER YOU
• Competitive salary
• Benefits related to location of the position. Preferable location of the position is Germany, Spain, Norway, Macedonia.
• Flexible work hours and remote work options.
• Professional development opportunities.
• Vibrant and inclusive company culture
• All benefits are subject to local terms and regulations and may be changes during the employment

LOCATION: Preferable location of the position is Germany, Spain, Norway, Macedonia.

Apply as soon as possible. Applications are evaluated on an ongoing basis.

Questions about the position? Contact: Patricia Bultó at patricia.bulto@linkmobility.com

LINK Mobility is publicly listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with offices in 17 countries throughout Europe. We continue to experience strong organic growth and recurring revenue as businesses move more activities onto mobile platforms. In 2022, LINK Mobility had a total turnover of 5.5 billion NOK.

Every employee is an important member of LINK Mobility. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind – whether active or passive – based on ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, gender, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, union membership, political views, age, or any other characteristic that results in compromising the principle of equality. LINK regards diversity as a lever for innovation and profitability

jobs_results.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs_results.description:
Seedify is a leading Web3 Gaming Incubator and Launchpad for Web3 projects focusing on innovative technologies such as DeFi, AI, Big Data, NFTs, and Web3 Gaming. By staking $SFUND, you gain the advantage of early access to purchase project tokens, enhancing your position within the Web3 landscape. Our industry encompasses Crypto, Gaming, IDOs, and INOs. We operate as a highly-driven and fast-paced startup, we embrace a remote work culture, allowing our team to collaborate from anywhere in the world.

Job Description:

We are looking for a talented UX/UI Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating intuitive user interfaces and delightful user experiences for our UGC Dashboards and INO/IDO Launchpads. You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and business requirements, and translate them into wireframes, prototypes, and design mockups. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for... detail, a passion for user-centered design, and the ability to think creatively to solve complex design problems. Additionally, you will participate in design reviews, usability testing, and iterate designs based on feedback to ensure the best possible user experience.

Responsibilities:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define user requirements and design solutions.Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups using tools like Figma.Conduct user research, analyze user feedback, and iterate designs based on findings.Implement best practices in UX/UI design, including accessibility and responsive design principles.Stay updated on industry (Web3 Gaming, Launchpads) trends and emerging technologies in UX/UI design.

Qualifications and Skills:

Minimum of 3 years of experience in UX/UI design, preferably in the Crypto or Gaming industries.Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools.Knowledge of interaction design, information architecture, and visual design principles.Familiarity with Google's Material Design guidelines and responsive design principles.Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Portfolio showcasing previous design work, including wireframes, prototypes, and design mockups.

Qualities in the Top 1%:

User Empathy - Ideal candidates will love our Users as much as we do.

Ownership - Tackling ambiguity, having a sense of ownership and being willing to tackle problems independently.

Curiosity - Go the extra mile so that we can create a User Experience that is unraveled anywhere else. Your work will be creating a benchmark for other players in our Industry

jobs_results.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
jobs_results.description:
Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.p.

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy Retail businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

We have been licensing Kraken for over 3 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their... customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

We're looking for a Senior UX/UI Designer to join the Kraken Tech team. We build technology to help energy and other suppliers to manage their customers and most business operations from our first-in-class platform. We’re passionate about designing simple, elegant user experiences, and using human-centred design as a source of inspiration to solve complex problems on behalf of our current customers. You'll be joining the design team, and will be working primarily with group product teams to help improve how users interact with the features and tools available or being built on Kraken.

What You'll Do
• You’ll be improving the user experience and interface of different areas of Kraken, and help shape how our users will interact with them.
• Work day-to-day in a cross-functional team with different stakeholders (developers, PMs, users, clients) when designing new features and products.
• Collaborate to building and maintaining our Design system, its library, documentation and patternsWork on User research, UX and UI end-to-end.
• Share designs for feedback early & often and offer design feedback to other team members.
• Plan and facilitate workshops, user interviews, usability testing and discovery activities to understand how we can best meet users’ needsConfidently delegate smaller tasks and projects to more junior designers, to better prioritise your time.
• Refining and adding to our design process documentation, onboarding materials and trying out new design processes with the team where possible.
• Communicate with both technical and non-technical colleagues, successfully supporting in defining roadmaps for projects with big picture strategy

What You'll Have
• At least 4 years of professional experience designing digital products.
• Experience working with Design Systems and component libraries.
• High proficiency with Figma - It is our main design toolDesign processes, knowing what steps are needed and which ones can be skipped based on the specific project or problem you are working on.
• The ability to clearly communicate and motivate design decisions to team members and stakeholdersExperience working with teams composed of designers, PMs, Front-End and Back-End developers.
• Attention to detail when designing, being precise and ensuring something is done well rather than fast but poorly.
• The ability to focus on user needs and knowing how to improve usability/UXA focus on accessibility and inclusion when designing components, interfaces and interactions.
• Fluent English + more languages are beneficial.

You'll also need to a have at least a basic understanding of/experience with:
• Considering front-end frameworks (Bootstrap, React…), HTML and CSS to be able to communicate your designs with devs and find workarounds when feasibility issues occur.
• Participating in project stand-up meetings with developers.
• Usage of project management software like Asana, knowledge of the agile process and organising work with tasks.
• Knowledge of web accessibility and designing for accessibility.
• Using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar…).
• Performing user interviews and user testing.

You do need to be able to work in Spain/EU without a VISA though.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who thrives on providing alternative opinions, challenging those around them and being challenged

Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

We're looking for a Senior UX/UI Designer to join the Kraken Tech team. We build technology to help energy and other suppliers to manage their customers and most business operations from our first-in-class platform. We’re passionate about designing simple, elegant user experiences, and using human-centred design as a source of inspiration to solve complex problems on behalf of our current customers. You'll be joining the design team, and will be working primarily with group product teams to help improve how users interact with the features and tools available or being built on Kraken.

What You'll Do
• You’ll be improving the user experience and interface of different areas of Kraken, and help shape how our users will interact with them.
• Work day-to-day in a cross-functional team with different stakeholders (developers, PMs, users, clients) when designing new features and products.
• Collaborate to building and maintaining our Design system, its library, documentation and patternsWork on User research, UX and UI end-to-end.
• Share designs for feedback early & often and offer design feedback to other team members.
• Plan and facilitate workshops, user interviews, usability testing and discovery activities to understand how we can best meet users’ needsConfidently delegate smaller tasks and projects to more junior designers, to better prioritise your time.
• Refining and adding to our design process documentation, onboarding materials and trying out new design processes with the team where possible.
• Communicate with both technical and non-technical colleagues, successfully supporting in defining roadmaps for projects with big picture strategy

What You'll Have
• At least 4 years of professional experience designing digital products.
• Experience working with Design Systems and component libraries.
• High proficiency with Figma - It is our main design toolDesign processes, knowing what steps are needed and which ones can be skipped based on the specific project or problem you are working on.
• The ability to clearly communicate and motivate design decisions to team members and stakeholdersExperience working with teams composed of designers, PMs, Front-End and Back-End developers.
• Attention to detail when designing, being precise and ensuring something is done well rather than fast but poorly.
• The ability to focus on user needs and knowing how to improve usability/UXA focus on accessibility and inclusion when designing components, interfaces and interactions.
• Fluent English + more languages are beneficial.

You'll also need to a have at least a basic understanding of/experience with:
• Considering front-end frameworks (Bootstrap, React…), HTML and CSS to be able to communicate your designs with devs and find workarounds when feasibility issues occur.
• Participating in project stand-up meetings with developers.
• Usage of project management software like Asana, knowledge of the agile process and organising work with tasks.
• Knowledge of web accessibility and designing for accessibility.
• Using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar…).
• Performing user interviews and user testing.

You do need to be able to work in Spain/EU without a VISA though.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who thrives on providing alternative opinions, challenging those around them and being challenged

jobs_results.title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
jobs_results.description:
Lingokids' mission is to help 100 million families worldwide raise amazing kids through playlearning™.

Through play and interactive technology, Lingokids delivers premium, modern learning through educational subjects and life skills so kids can thrive as confident, conscious, resilient, lifelong learners — ready for school and today’s ever-changing world.

Are you ready for Playlearning?™

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to be a key contributor to the UX team, focusing on creating delightful experiences for our users.

You will be part of a cross-functional squad and tackle all aspects of the design process. In addition, you will be working as part of the UX team and collaborating closely with colleagues from other squads and disciplines.

Responsibilities
• Leading the team in product discovery and delivery in partnership with product management and engineering.
• Aligning on a desired product outcome and the user problem to be pursued by the team and with... leadership.
• Engaging with users on a frequent basis through qualitative and quantitative research to deeply understand their needs and desires and continuously learn how we can add value.
• Structuring user and market insights into opportunities that drive the desired business outcome, and prioritizing them together with the team.
• Taking the lead in generating solutions for those opportunities and setting up lean experiments (or other suitable approaches) to validate the underlying assumptions and hypotheses.
• Developing the final visual design and interaction model of the validated solutions.
• Participate in measuring the impact of solutions after launch and feeding learnings into the following iterations.

Desired experience
• Experience leading design in Product teams who has a passion for creating experiences in the children/parent space.
• 7+ years of experience as a product designer in a similar role.
• You've shipped several products and many features for consumer-facing products..
• Experience with designing for conversion, transactions and subscription-based products.
• Have a love for the craft of Product Design and understand the full process. You have years of experience with the product designer’s toolkit and know-how and when to use it.
• Strong knowledge of Figma, our design tool of choice. Amongst others, such as Sketch, Miro and the Adobe Suite.

English is a must. We are a multicultural team, and we are providing a service in English so, we don't care about certificates, but we expect you to be able to communicate fluently.

You should feel equally comfortable communicating in long-form writing. We have become a fully remote company so, we believe that being articulate in both spoken and written long-form asynchronous communication is key to working efficiently together.

Experience working closely with non-technical stakeholders to refine requirements and bring them to life is a must.

Life at Lingokids

🏡 Remote working: you can choose to work remotely from within your country or visit our offices if you live in Madrid.

⚖️ Flexible hours and work-life balance: we care about the results you bring to the team. 9 to 6 and constant commuting is not for us either.

📈 Stock options: joining Lingokids means you can choose to own part of the company.

🌍 Visa sponsorship: if you need a visa to work in the EU, Lingokids will assist you during the visa process, costs included.

📚 Professional growth: up to €2.000 per year for conferences, books, and training.

💬 Language lessons: language learning is what we’re all about! We’ll cover language classes for you to learn Spanish, English or Portuguese.

🩺 Health Insurance: we offer an optional health insurance through Adeslas, featuring competitive rates to ensure your well-being.

🧠 Mental Health Support: we offer you 4 free TherapySide sessions to support your self-awareness and well-being.

💳 Flexible compensation: you'll be able to include your monthly expenses in meals and transportations into your payroll (we use Cobee).

🍲 Meal allowances: every month, you will receive a 60€ allowance on your Cobee card for you to spend on the restaurants and food delivery services.

🖥 Home office setup: you'll have a 400€ allowance in your first payroll to set up your home office and a 35€ monthly allowance for remote expenses.

🙌 Feedback culture: feedback is the breakfast of champions, and we take it seriously! We have a real-time and honest feedback culture, and a formal 360º assessment every 6 months.

If you think you don't tick all the boxes, we'd still love to hear from you. Nobody checks every box, and we are looking for someone excited to join the team
